objective: Close the C32 balanced partial-Latin boundary obligation when two complete short fibers are available, preserve actual per-leaf matching and one-use core ownership, and extend multiplicity-independent O(r) packing defect beyond the square-root range.

atomic_claims.text: For odd m and all b,D, the mechanical-word set C and triples (s+t,s-t,2s) form a partial cyclic Latin square with D occurrences per selected symbol, floor-or-ceiling row and column loads, simple pair projections, and exact completion by the unselected cyclic triples.

Two wholly short m-fibers plus b selected vertices of a third fiber admit an actual p-leaf resource packet with defect at most 7m for odd p and below 17m/2 for positive even p; every leaf color is a matching and every deleted color edge is charged exactly once as one core plus two endpoint units.
For r=3^k, m=3^s, a=hm+b with 2<=h<=r/m-1 and 0<b<m, if floor(p/2)+floor(q/2)<=(m-1)/2, an actual host packing has total defect below 13r/3 and hence nu_star-nu below 13r/9.

For arbitrary actual A with 6(p+q+1)<=|A|<=r-1, choosing the least power of three m>=p+q+1 and combining C32 on divisible cardinalities with C33 otherwise gives total defect below 13r/3; p and q may grow linearly with r on this explicit domain.

Generator-side exact runs exited zero and checked 956 balanced arrays, 843 boundary parameter rows, 26 complete edge-owner blow-ups, and five rejected mutations; these runs do not prove the universal claims.

assumptions: Finite simple two-neighborhood split hosts with core order a power of three and an actual arbitrary short subset transported from the abstract construction.
The C32 Vizing/Misra-Gries packet-coloring premise is inherited; C33 adds no new external theorem.
The gap estimate uses only the universal all-one-third upper bound; no unproved full-face equality is assumed.
Every reported short and long color is an actual matching; Q, J, L_D and J_fix are not substituted for nu.
risks: The theorem requires two complete short fibers at a scale large enough for the combined direction demand; one-buffer and no-buffer regimes remain open.
The repository checker is source-equivalent to the locally executed checker but byte identity is not asserted.
Finite runs, PR review, CI and merge are transport/generator facts, not mathematical Evidence.
No exact nu optimum, whole one-third-face theorem, exact split domination, or ProblemContract closure is claimed.
